However, alcohol can irritate your stomach and worsen acid reflux, making omeprazole feel less effective.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXjCtfBLkmFToF5BFcdupS_JXqq5fiQ4qAL8WqVNPgwdmhfSYpoxDlgq9SOfDF6A-FEF7T4jLzmBDhOSq_zNTyIa9YNWaK03l1234Nx_pba8jEfkTJ6Ocvu_j6f_k1Qn7vUAk3bzmgv0K4WCXWNg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXWiuhbgt01spVqcxqHCscm-0yaI427bh6k2iy7HziQ2gCSWbVDpPq_Jj0vKq-U5FQ3LPg3EFsOPHVPHZYzmO4F7VA6vR31So-GqhgYx_tUChqYhohNhFGoK2Jo99nDsjZ)

### How Alcohol Affects Your Treatment

- **Worsens reflux symptoms:** Alcohol increases stomach acid and relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter, which can trigger heartburn and acid reflux.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXjCtfBLkmFToF5BFcdupS_JXqq5fiQ4qAL8WqVNPgwdmhfSYpoxDlgq9SOfDF6A-FEF7T4jLzmBDhOSq_zNTyIa9YNWaK03l1234Nx_pba8jEfkTJ6Ocvu_j6f_k1Qn7vUAk3bzmgv0K4WCXWNg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX76wHuQfwDahaMzSfw_FnJqyrnWAgeQTs9V-Ai2S2dH7A3PxGPGGBxajS7IiwsiIxNWf4Dh91c0DCpeFxJnmjX3Bs0S3yPJhY-9YVQII5L2gAm0AUP7HhuY_XpaSuJWTs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXdQoMDN0lZ08NGCPMb8ozjL_9yxghITfDupqoBxbKPkpCsY6AoNpTNHseAeGg8opc3_mwUqdlybxUdoIvnUvjmcrSkPp1wd30cAXvCIU8Fb5UPTNZUoNpEPfw5vtQHoKASYaOCjY)
- **Irritates the stomach lining:** Drinking can aggravate conditions like gastritis, esophagitis, and stomach ulcers, causing pain or burning.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXWiuhbgt01spVqcxqHCscm-0yaI427bh6k2iy7HziQ2gCSWbVDpPq_Jj0vKq-U5FQ3LPg3EFsOPHVPHZYzmO4F7VA6vR31So-GqhgYx_tUChqYhohNhFGoK2Jo99nDsjZ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-RKRL9jNiseSsLziC-SYsYHzrKh1ArTnaIXfqA0z1j2jTdml9iPytJXg6ayRaOEI5BXEXQSz-ZUiXC8jnWfV8Ghv03Akovd8iiUtN3wzecB65YIfRZx-AIldXjaBR9rKV0MKpm_Fk_Kgh2kPsL8Zk69rCTdsBJt1g3u9wicGJ_7HYbsk95osgw)
- **Antibiotic interactions:** If you take omeprazole as part of an *H. pylori* infection treatment, avoid alcohol because it can interact with the accompanying antibiotics.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-)
- **Liver and long-term risks:** Heavy or regular drinking combined with long-term omeprazole use may add strain to the liver and increase risks of stomach irritation or nutrient absorption issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF122PT4KenOJtxioRUe4_oaDlbv6EM58b4J1VqYyH7OZL2RgtnjYrG4IbaIOP6oo4HyNb76wg6MuavqkbslcSl-1RC23ZZOe2KLSVyuyKeAbqVavprnXCtbxS6-sP1uIEeX5BaGbTMp4qHqjYzdXwHtNZLD3xPdSBHtQZXgi-83X9KeHr35Ar)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXjCtfBLkmFToF5BFcdupS_JXqq5fiQ4qAL8WqVNPgwdmhfSYpoxDlgq9SOfDF6A-FEF7T4jLzmBDhOSq_zNTyIa9YNWaK03l1234Nx_pba8jEfkTJ6Ocvu_j6f_k1Qn7vUAk3bzmgv0K4WCXWNg)

#### Practical Tips

- **Keep it moderate:** Limit intake or skip alcohol if you are actively treating reflux, ulcers, or stomach pain. For guidance on acid reflux and drinking, see [HealthCentral](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-RKRL9jNiseSsLziC-SYsYHzrKh1ArTnaIXfqA0z1j2jTdml9iPytJXg6ayRaOEI5BXEXQSz-ZUiXC8jnWfV8Ghv03Akovd8iiUtN3wzecB65YIfRZx-AIldXjaBR9rKV0MKpm_Fk_Kgh2kPsL8Zk69rCTdsBJt1g3u9wicGJ_7HYbsk95osgw)
- **Watch drink choices:** Carbonated drinks (like beer) and acidic drinks (like wine or citrus mixers) tend to trigger reflux more easily.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXjCtfBLkmFToF5BFcdupS_JXqq5fiQ4qAL8WqVNPgwdmhfSYpoxDlgq9SOfDF6A-FEF7T4jLzmBDhOSq_zNTyIa9YNWaK03l1234Nx_pba8jEfkTJ6Ocvu_j6f_k1Qn7vUAk3bzmgv0K4WCXWNg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF120sbg7BOyI7kmT3TGdNq96cAIEMf7GNfKEBd8hhUGVjG_udY12zeCaFSFibvyVd9nK7Kf0vmMLr-xwUFJM5H-hq4JUfU17slY32JjlCDiBnaDbx5GXE15c0GrqxuiNfm9y7zqMzSO4mCws_iVVpOubUxmLlND0d-JqECNVoHHt8Ap_fHurtMMCRBu7vCAUbjA_Glkbz)
- **Take omeprazole consistently:** Omeprazole works best when taken daily before a meal rather than as a last-minute fix right before drinking. You can review general usage guidance from the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXyTuiCUSjCbzcDj2apfD6QDsWqauU-tPiHLntnQ9i6spehMVvHkyUbTQEHYjKHVH3bcbWgkxO3ulYJ0Uu9PFrQ7JZ3E_LPHQm34rU6PTOR5Avj65WMKdTmTJcBjTqcg).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXIIKZ9gWeLwI52htp_AxqnMYkM07nk_syMRSVYg_mZFbgPBCss7F_ns20_CJGkcsENgxe5jw1f68xhroCy_fRySIldVn-SVwnpnaRXADCMTgkCE8Gtf6G1OohamhVcQgbXHng73h2YKk74OYVvgv-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX76wHuQfwDahaMzSfw_FnJqyrnWAgeQTs9V-Ai2S2dH7A3PxGPGGBxajS7IiwsiIxNWf4Dh91c0DCpeFxJnmjX3Bs0S3yPJhY-9YVQII5L2gAm0AUP7HhuY_XpaSuJWTs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXyTuiCUSjCbzcDj2apfD6QDsWqauU-tPiHLntnQ9i6spehMVvHkyUbTQEHYjKHVH3bcbWgkxO3ulYJ0Uu9PFrQ7JZ3E_LPHQm34rU6PTOR5Avj65WMKdTmTJcBjTqcg)
